data.define: Slang for something excellent or stylish.

misuse.text: Don't yell 'fire' in a crowded room.

data.l1_hook: انظر إلى حذائي الرياضي الجديد! إنه "fire"!

native.tip: “fire” = رائع جداً. مثال: “Those sneakers are fire!”
